actions_taken: Audited all six top-level xyz.artiji/commerce fields and separated field-category gaps from merchant-chosen values.
Drafted a two-paragraph normative MPP-over-MCP addition binding the existing receipt to taskId and preserving it across tasks/get and notifications/tasks.
Generated and committed deterministic byte-exact HTTP entity-body vectors for challenge, paid success, replay, working poll, and completed poll.
Added a reproduction test that regenerates the vector flow and verifies every request/response body and SHA-256 digest byte-for-byte.
Drafted a 232-word issue #292 follow-up that leads with the three required corrections and then reports the working example.
Re-read the current MCP Tasks draft and recorded the fixture's reduced non-conformant task shape plus all other material limitations.
key_results: All 6/6 extension fields are SPEC_GAP at the field-category level; their eight scalar values remain merchant-specific.

Discovery does not compose cleanly for the required paid deferred-service terms, while the runtime flow works only after implementation-defined idempotency, claim, receipt-binding, and artifact-correlation rules.
The minimal upstream change needs no new field and belongs only in MPP-over-MCP transport composition, not MPP core or the Stripe method.
Paid success and replay are byte-identical, use one fake provider request, and preserve the same receipt through working and completed polls.
The full P1-P6 suite passes 15/15 tests.
The vectors must not be represented as MCP conformance vectors because the fixture omits current required Task fields and terminal result nesting.

assumptions_made.assumption: SPEC_GAP classifies a missing interoperable field category, while each merchant remains responsible for the value and policy content.
assumptions_made.invalidation_condition: Reviewers define merchant-specific to include every standard category whose value is selected by a merchant.

assumptions_made.assumption: The same Payment Receipt means the same logical receipt values carried under the existing org.paymentauth/receipt key, without adding identity or settlement fields.
assumptions_made.invalidation_condition: The transport draft defines a different receipt replacement, refresh, or lifecycle model.

assumptions_made.assumption: Deterministic synthetic HTTP entity bodies and hashes are useful implementation evidence when explicitly distinguished from conformance vectors.
assumptions_made.invalidation_condition: The fixture changes, the hashes no longer reproduce, or reviewers require a fully conformant multi-implementation vector suite.

scope_creep_surfaced: Updating the seller and buyer to the complete current MCP Tasks wire shape was not absorbed into P6; it is a prerequisite before publishing the vectors as conformance evidence.
The six discovery gaps were not folded into the receipt lifecycle diff; they require separate design work.
No public issue comment or pull request was posted.
No notification transport, hosted gateway, second Stripe payment, refund, dispute, or settlement-finality work was added.
next_phase_readiness_reason: The six-phase plan is complete. Public posting is not ready as conformance evidence until the reduced MCP Tasks wire shape is corrected and the vectors are regenerated.
